'''The Golden Barge''' is an inn in [[So Habor]], a city in [[Altara]].

==Appearance==
The Golden Barge has the look of a prosperous inn. It is three stories tall and built from neatly dressed gray stone and has a slate roof. It is owned by Mistress [[Vadere]].

==Activities==
When [[Perrin Aybara]] and his group come into So Habor, they meet with [[Rahema Arnon]] and [[Mycal Crossin]], who are grain merchants. After some bartering done by [[Berelain sur Paendrag Paeron]], they agree on a price. The price, however, goes down when perrin discovers that the grain in the warehouses is infested with weevils.{{ref/book|10|26}}
